# @ndigo/ai

Provider-agnostic agent contracts: chat messages, streaming events, structured output, and a tool-calling loop over MCP tools

Version-matched export index for the installed package. Read `README.md`
for usage; the workspace guide index ships with `@ndigo/cli` as
`assets/agent/docs-index.md`.

## Public exports

- `AIAgent` — Drives one model through a bounded tool-calling loop.
- `AIAgentOptions` *(type)* — Agent construction options.
- `AIAgentStream` *(type)* — The streaming run handle: an async generator of events whose return value is the settled AIRunResult.
- `AIRateLimitOptions` *(type)* — Per-run rate-limit policy. The limiter is the shared `@ndigo/rate-limit` backend; the key defaults to `provider:model`.
- `AIRolloutOptions` *(type)* — Model-rollout gate. The flag is evaluated as a boolean with a `false` default, so a broken or missing flag disables the model (fail closed).
- `AIRunRequest` *(type)* — One agent run request.
- `AIRunResult` *(type)* — The settled result of a run.
- `AIStreamEvent` *(type)* — Incremental events from AIAgent.stream.
- `AIModelDisabledError` — The model rollout flag evaluated to `false`, so the agent refused the call.
- `AIRateLimitError` — The rate limiter refused the model call. The caller may retry after AIRateLimitError.retryAfterMs.
- `AIFinishReason` *(type)* — Why a model step or the whole run finished. `max-steps` is produced by the agent loop; the remaining values mirror the provider finish reasons.
- `AIMessage` *(type)* — One message in a conversation.
- `AITokenUsage` *(type)* — Token usage reported by a provider. Fields are optional because not every provider reports every counter; the agent sums the values it receives.
- `AIToolCall` *(type)* — A tool call produced by a model. `input` is the decoded JSON arguments object; the model's schema has already been applied by the adapter.
- `AIToolResult` *(type)* — A completed tool execution, as reported in `AIRunResult`.
- `AIModel` *(type)* — The provider-neutral language-model contract.
- `AIModelInfo` *(type)* — Human-readable model identity used in telemetry attributes and rate-limit keys.
- `AIObjectRequest` *(type)* — A structured-output request: the model must return an object matching the Zod schema.
- `AIObjectResult` *(type)* — A structured-output result.
- `AIStepRequest` *(type)* — One model call, including the full conversation so far and the tools the model may call. Adapters MUST NOT execute tools: the agent loop does that, which keeps…
- `AIStepResult` *(type)* — One completed model step: text, tool calls (if any), and usage.
- `AIStepStream` *(type)* — A streaming model step. The generator returns the settled step once the provider stream ends.
- `AIStepStreamEvent` *(type)* — Incremental step output. The agent forwards `text-delta` events and collects `tool-call` events; the generator's return value is the settled AIStepResult.
- `AIServerSentEvent` *(type)* — One SSE frame produced from an AIStreamEvent.
- `toServerSentEvents` — Maps agent events to `ServerSentEventView` frames.
- `AIToolCallContext` *(type)* — Per-call context passed to AIToolSource.call. The `callId` is the model-assigned tool-call id and is recorded as `gen_ai.tool.call.id`.
- `AIToolDescriptor` *(type)* — One tool as reported by a source: the same shape as MCP `tools/list` entries (`name`, `description`, JSON Schema `inputSchema`).
- `AIToolSource` *(type)* — A source of tools the agent may call. Implementations decide where tools live and how they execute; `McpToolRegistry` is the canonical one.
